item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem:
Meera's grandmother cooks rotis using jowar and bajra flour at their home in Maharashtra. Meera's friend says these small grains are ordinary grains with little nutritional value.
Which statement correctly describes grains such as jowar, bajra, ragi, and sanwa?

options.A: They are millets, native crops of India that are highly nutritious and rich in vitamins and minerals such as iron.
options.B: They are pulses that are grown mainly for their protein-rich seeds.
options.C: They are ordinary grains with very little nutritional value.
options.D: They are imported cereals that cannot be grown in India.
